items.title: A thickening of algebraic spaces induces an equivalence of small etale sites
items.author: The Stacks Project Authors
items.work: Stacks Project, chapter spaces-more-morphisms.tex (More on Morphisms of Spaces)

items.difficulty_reason: For a thickening X subset X' of algebraic spaces over S, base change V' maps to V = X x_{X'} V' and defines an equivalence of small etale sites X'_etale to X_etale. The retained proof is a written two-step reduction: the same functor is an equivalence on the big etale sites of spaces by the chapter's topological invariance theorem, so it remains to check that an object of the big etale site is a scheme if and only if its restriction to X is, and that equivalence is precisely the content of the thickening-scheme lemma collected beside it. Retained author proof at lines 1827-1834.
